eps.t: The Kaiju Girl Appears in Tokyo
eps.ov: Outsider Kuroe begins to experience the complicated physiological changes of adolescence.
Following her outburst, Kuroe deals with the consequences of her growing mutual attraction.

eps.t: A Sparkling Weekend ~Where Dreams Come True~
eps.ov: Kuroe accepts Minami's invitation to a theme park, with a gameplan in mind in case kaiju appear.
Rinko's old paramour returns to take Kuroe to a heavy metal festival.
A new school year puts Kuroe in class with an unexpected ally.
A field trip gives Kuroe and Minami a chance to grow closer, while Raimu deals with an unexpected problem.
Arata deals with the fallout of his newfound fame.
Manatsu takes a trip to woo Harugon and invites Kuroe and Raimu to be her wingmen.

eps.t: Release the Torrent of Complaints, Kaiju Girl!
eps.ov: Arata's first TV appearance sparks an influx of insecurities for Kuroe.
Kuroe bonds with a kindred spirit while experiencing friction in her relationship with Arata.
While Kuroe is at rock bottom, a giant flying kaiju threatens the city.

eps.t: Charge This One Strike with Love
eps.ov: The threat of the flying kaiju continues as all hope seems lost.
